title: Crimson Moon
description: Crimson Moon is a Gothic High Renaissance action-adventure RPG built around intense, replayable missions that blend brutal precision with deep character progression. Set in the besieged city of Gildenarch, players hack and slash their way through cathedrals, battlements, and shadowed districts overrun by demons, vampires, and undead gods. Players can venture alone or bring a friend in optional co-op as they wield angelic power and fight back the Infernal Legion.

critic_reviews.quote: Crimson Moon is a great time, and when everything is considered, is a must try for those that can’t get enough roguelike action.

At the end of the day, Crimson Moon doesn’t need to reinvent the Soulslike genre to be worth your time. It knows exactly what it wants to be, a quick, loot-heavy romp you can tackle solo or with a friend, and it does that well enough to earn a spot in your rotation. The camera hiccups and a few control quirks keep it from being a home run, but for $20, it’s an easy recommendation. Sometimes a game doesn’t have to blow you away to be worth playing, and Crimson Moon proves that.

For what it is right now, Crimson Moon’s $20 price tag is entirely appropriate. I had a lot of fun with the game’s combat, which supports both solo and duo play. I can easily see developer Probably Monsters adding more levels, monsters, and gear. With a few patches to iron out the camera, Crimson Moon will be a solid choice for fans of fantasy action.
While its less-than-stellar features can be a game-breaker for some, Crimson Moon is an engaging, unique game that offers several great features.

Crimson Moon is a game I knew I’d like going in, purely as a big fan of the genres, but I was very glad to see that the game was able to mostly stand on its own as well. From the gorgeous visuals to the responsive combat, I very much enjoyed the ten hours or so it took me to hit credits, and I plan on continuing to play it for at least another five to ten more. The lack of weapon variety is the main area I’d hope to see a significant improvement on, and the game does have post-launch plans, so we’ll have to see. If you’re a fan of killing demons and the like as an angelic force of destruction, then Crimson Moon is easily worth the $19.99 USD asking price. And hell, even if you’re not, it might still be worth it just to have another fun co-op game to play with friends.

Crimson Moon serves as an exceptionally welcoming gateway into the roguelite genre, cleverly pairing Diablo-inspired angelic aesthetics with forgiving progression mechanics like purifiable gear retention and extra lives. Its flexible difficulty options and impactful loot builds ensure accessible action for newcomers while offering a satisfying loop for seasoned players. However, recurring camera glitches in narrow spaces and boss fights, coupled with uninspired enemy design and frequent PC crashes, hold back its potential. Despite these technical stumbles, its striking visual duality and beginner-friendly design make it an enjoyable entry point for genre-curious gamers.
Crimson Moon is no masterpiece in a year replete with them, but it’s a decent debut for ProbablyMonsters, nonetheless.

Crimson Moon is a decent run-based action game with interesting lore. Its combat lacks the “oomph” to make it a satisfying experience, and there are times that make the experience feel like a slog, but it can be fun if you’re looking for something to enjoy while catching up on podcasts.

There was clearly an attempt to make a good game here. While Crimson Moon’s Unreal Engine-driven environments and the great progression system try their best to carry the experience, the final result is constantly suffocated by the convoluted story, a limited weapon pool, and a lack of accessibility options. Even when the co-op action starts to click, the lethal camera system and the game’s inability to prepare you for its mechanics quickly kill the momentum.

user_reviews.author: Matlard
user_reviews.quote:
Amazing one for only 20€.
If you are looking for a triple A, move out. But, if you are looking for a pleasant game, whith souls mechanicals, online with a friend, and have fun for many hours, this is a really good game. People crys against the keybinding, but you also can change it, that's all, or play with a controller, which i recommanded.
Well, very good game for 20€ !
